title: Press the square pass
brief: You are pressing their centre-back high up the pitch. Watch where the ball goes.
briefKid: You are chasing their defender near their goal. Watch the ball.
question: They have passed it across to their other centre-back. Where do you go?
questionKid: They passed to their other defender. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: A pass across their back line is your cue: sprint to the new receiver and arrive goal-side, a couple of metres away, so they can't play forward.
takeaway.kid: A pass across is your signal: sprint to the new player and get close.

misconceptions.text: You stayed on the first centre-back, so the one with the ball has all the time in the world.
misconceptions.textKid: The ball moved, so go to the player who has it now.

misconceptions.text: You stopped too far off, so they have time to look up and pass through you; close them down to a couple of metres.
misconceptions.textKid: You are too far away, so get close to the ball.

notes: Our right winger is keyed out to their left-back as the ball is switched, on the path the shape gives him with everyone on their spot. With auto players running at timeline runSpeed he was still tucked in, nearest their centre-back, when the ball arrived, and took the press that is this drill's lesson (2026-10-03).
